## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r tidyverse}
install.packages("tidyverse")
```

```{r descr}
install.packages("descr")
```

```{r knitr}
install.packages("knitr")
```

```{r dplyr}
install.packages("dplyr")
```

```{r library}
library(tidyverse)
library(descr)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
```

```{r load-data}
file_path <- "/cloud/project/Data/Original Data/data.xls"

data.xls <- read_excel(file_path)

head(data.xls)
```

```{r religious orientations}
freq(as.ordered(data.xls$A3.8), plot = FALSE)
```

\^This table explains the frequency of different religious orientations among a sample.

```{r education levels}
freq(as.ordered(data.xls$A3.10), plot = FALSE)

```

\^This table explains how much education a person within a sample has achieved.

```{r COVID-19 anxiety}
freq(as.ordered(data.xls$`A5.3*`), plot = FALSE)

```

\^This table explains the levels of anxiety a person experienced from the COVID-19 pandemic.

```{r mask frequency}
freq(as.ordered(data.xls$A31.4), plot = FALSE)

```

\^This table shows the frequency in which a person used a mask during the COVID-19 pandemic.

```{r distance away frequency}
freq(as.ordered(data.xls$A31.6), plot = FALSE)

```

\^This table shows the frequency in which a person kept a distance of 1.5 meters away from others.
